items.label: Modbot: dump post state
items.description: Show the modbot's Redis state for this post in a toast.

items.label: Modbot: purge redaction edits
items.description: Sweep recently edited comments and remove any matching a configured redaction signature. Honors the Redaction cleanup mode setting.

aiGateMode.label: AI disclosure gate
aiGateMode.helpText: Requires OP to reply to a sticky comment confirming AI tool usage. Posts are removed until OP replies.

aiTopicDayMode.label: AI-topic day gate
aiTopicDayMode.helpText: Removes posts with an AI-topic link flair (e.g. 'AI/LLM') when submitted outside the allowed UTC weekdays (currently Wednesday and Saturday).

flairPostMode.label: Flair required on posts
flairPostMode.helpText: Removes posts by users without a user flair on the subreddit.

flairCommentMode.label: Flair required on comments
flairCommentMode.helpText: Removes comments by users without a user flair on the subreddit. The 'flair required' PSA on the bot's sticky comment is shown only when this is On or On + Discord.

engagementMode.label: OP engagement check
engagementMode.helpText: Removes posts where OP hasn't commented within the configured window, only if the comment threshold is met.

minKarmaMode.label: Minimum subreddit karma
minKarmaMode.helpText: Removes posts by users whose combined post + comment karma in this sub is below the threshold.

redactionMode.label: Redaction cleanup
redactionMode.helpText: Removes comments whose body has been overwritten by a history-scrubbing tool (Redact, PowerDeleteSuite, etc.), detected on edit via the signature list below. Also gates the 'purge redaction edits' mod menu action.

redactionSignatures.label: Redaction signatures
redactionSignatures.helpText: One regular expression per line, matched case-insensitively against the edited comment body. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored; a line that fails to compile is skipped and logged. Match on the tool's attribution footer, not on the filler text.

minKarmaThreshold.label: Karma threshold (post + comment)
minKarmaThreshold.helpText: Combined post + comment karma in this subreddit required to post. Default 10.

engagementWindowMinutes.label: Engagement window (minutes)
engagementWindowMinutes.helpText: How long after posting the bot waits before checking OP engagement. Default 120 (2 hours).

engagementMinComments.label: Engagement comment threshold
engagementMinComments.helpText: Minimum total comments before the engagement check will remove a post. Default 10.

discordWebhookUrl.label: Discord webhook URL
discordWebhookUrl.helpText: Optional. When a feature is set to 'Shadow + Discord', its log lines are POSTed here in addition to the regular log stream. Leave blank to disable.
